question.prompt: Toss 2 coins. What is the probability that both show heads? (The coins are fair. Express the result as a fraction in simplest form.)

solutions.explanation: A table or tree diagram gives 4 equally likely outcomes: (heads, heads), (heads, tails), (tails, heads), and (tails, tails). Only 1 outcome has both coins showing heads, so the probability is \(1/4\).
solutions.title: Enumerate the two-coin outcomes
